# Looper

> Looper is a dashboard for agentic processes and workflows that run on a schedule. Set up and see your looping, scheduled processes, the steps that power each one, and the KPIs that move it toward its objectives. Each loop is described in one Markdown spec. The code is open source on GitHub.

## Pages

- [Looper home](/): what Looper does, with screenshots of the dashboard, a loop page, spec and goals, and one-offs (sample data).
- [Loop spec format](/spec): the loop file format. Front matter fields, the sections of a spec, rules for self-rewrites, and a full example.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Verafyai/looper): the code, setup and data format.

## Facts

- Author: Rex St. John
- The screenshots on the home page use sample data, not real runs.
